article.headline: Danny Young scores 18 to lead New Haven to 63-55 victory over Army
article.description: — Danny Young had 18 points to help New Haven fend off Army 63-55 on Tuesday night.
article.linkText: Danny Young scores 18 to lead New Haven to 63-55 victory over Army

categories.description: Army Black Knights @ New Haven Chargers

event.description: Army Black Knights @ New Haven Chargers

keywords: Army Black Knights @ New Haven Chargers
article.story: WEST HAVEN, Conn. -- — Danny Young had 18 points to help New Haven fend off Army 63-55 on Tuesday night. Young shot 5 for 7 (1 for 3 from 3-point range) and 7 of 8 from the free-throw line for the Chargers (1-2). Andy Ramirez and Tim Walker both scored eight. Jacen Holloway led the way for the Black Knights (1-2) with 12 points and six rebounds. Patrick McDonough added 12 points and Ryan Curry scored eight. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
